scripts.start: npm run build && npm run server
scripts.build:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.build:mobile: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.apk:android: npm run build:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && mkdir -p ../release ../dist/downloads && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../release/task-flux-1.0.1.apk && cp ../release/task-flux-1.0.1.apk ../dist/downloads/task-flux-1.0.1.apk
scripts.bundle:android: npm run build:android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease && mkdir -p ../release && cp app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab ../release/task-flux-1.0.1.aab
